'''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V0-D-ig88-2022-07-31-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V0-D-ig88-2018-07-08.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V0-D-ig88-2022-07-31-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V0-D-ig88.gif]], 31 July 2022).
